Agent Name: Probability_Expert
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The simulation misimplemented the game mechanics for piston 2 and 3 firings. When piston 2 or 3 fires, the code failed to release the first-position ball and to reorder/refill the platform as specified (e.g., moving the third or second ball into first and bringing in two new balls). It instead popped only the targeted index and inserted ramp balls incorrectly. This mismatch invalidates the ejection frequency results and the conclusion that ball 2 is optimal.
